summary.text: Sheikh Rahman, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2018 and serves Senate District 5.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Rahman grew up in Bangladesh, came to the United States in 1981 to attend Central Piedmont Community College, and became a U.S. citizen in 1995.

The biography says he finished an undergraduate degree in economics and global studies at the University of Georgia, worked as an executive in the restaurant industry, and later worked in the convenience store and real estate business; it says he lives in Lawrenceville.
